headline: Sevilla's slump meets an Osasuna defence that leaks goals
summary: Sevilla have taken 1 point from their last 3 league games, including a 1-4 defeat at Real Madrid eight days ago. Sunday's visitors are Osasuna, who ended a month and a half without a win by beating Racing Santander 2-0. Their problem is at the back: 12 goals conceded in their last five games. Even so, Sevilla are 48.5% favourites — more than double Osasuna's 22.9% — and the market rates them about half a goal the stronger side, with the total at 2.25 goals.
read: Sevilla are 48.5% favourites at home and rated about half a goal the better side, even though they have taken one point from three games, including a 1-3 home defeat to Barcelona and a 1-4 loss at Real Madrid. Osasuna arrive having ended a month-and-a-half without a win by beating Racing Santander 2-0 with 3.65 xG, but they have conceded 12 goals in five, and the market sees a controlled game of about 2.25 goals.

facts.fact: Sevilla have taken one point from their last three league games: a 1-3 home defeat to Barcelona, a 3-3 draw at Levante and a 1-4 defeat at Real Madrid.
facts.meaning: The strong start — back-to-back 1-0 wins in September — has stalled, and Sevilla come home needing a response.

facts.fact: Sevilla are 48.5% to win at home, more than double Osasuna's 22.9%, with the draw at 28.6%.
facts.meaning: Sevilla are clear favourites but far from certain — the home win is close to a coin flip.

facts.fact: Osasuna ended a run without a win that Marca put at a month and a half by beating Racing Santander 2-0 on Sunday, with Budimir and Osambela scoring.
facts.meaning: They travel to Sevilla with the winless run off their back and a result to build on.

facts.fact: The market expects about 2.25 goals in this game, with Over priced at 49.6%.
facts.meaning: The total is right on the line — the market sees a controlled match rather than an open one.

facts.fact: Osasuna have conceded 12 goals in their last five games, giving up 1.92 xG per match.
facts.meaning: The away defence is the weakest part of their game, and Sevilla's front line will target it.

facts.fact: Osasuna won the last meeting 2-1 in April, and each of the last five between these two has finished as a draw or a one-goal win.
facts.meaning: Recent meetings have been decided by fine margins, which fits a market rating Sevilla only about half a goal the better side.

facts.fact: Sevilla are sixth on 14 points, three clear of Osasuna in tenth on 11.
facts.meaning: A win keeps Sevilla in the top six; a defeat would leave the two sides level on points.

facts.fact: One Sevilla midfielder, Giorgi Kochorashvili, has been missing from training this week, according to Mundo Deportivo.
facts.meaning: A possible midfield absence four days out — a training absence, not a confirmed injury.

sources.fact: Sevilla lost 4-1 at Real Madrid in their previous LaLiga match, with Kylian Mbappe scoring twice for Real.
Sevilla have lodged a formal complaint to LaLiga over refereeing decisions in their 4-1 defeat at Real Madrid, including Arda Guler not being sent off and a challenge by Ibrahima Konate on Oso.
Spanish media report that Giorgi Kochorashvili has been absent from Sevilla training as the squad prepares for Osasuna.
ABC reports that Sevilla coach Luis Garcia Plaza will have all three of his forwards available for the Osasuna match if nothing changes.
Sevilla have taken only one point from their last three league games against Barcelona, Levante and Real Madrid, though they remain sixth in the table.
El Desmarque reports that Sevilla see the Osasuna match as a chance to return to winning ways and keep their good start to the season going.
Osasuna ended a month-and-a-half without a win thanks to goals from Budimir and Osambela, according to Marca.
Marca reports that the recent win has brought a smile back to Osasuna under coach Arrasate.
